name: Writing Tools
description: Spelling, grammar, phrasing, dictionary and thesaurus support while composing chat messages, posts and comments, in British or American English: a 120,000-word dictionary per language with corrections ranked by how the slip is usually made and how common the word is, more than 630 grammar rules -- from subject and verb agreement to the preposition a word takes -- and nearly 190 phrasing suggestions that explain what is wrong and why, a check for words written for one another (real and reel, their and there) decided by the words around them, twelve checks that run across a whole message, including a calendar check on written dates, and definitions and synonyms covering 86% of the dictionary. Fully local -- all datasets ship inside the plugin, and it never sees a word you type.
summary: Spelling, grammar and phrasing checks as you write, with a dictionary and thesaurus. Fully local.
